title: Clarify Libraries staged and saved UI state
summary: Improve the WebView Libraries tab so profile selection, staged editor state, backend route-map evidence, preview/save feedback, warnings, and validation handoff remain visibly distinct.
reason: The Libraries audit found that route-map evidence could look current while profile edits were staged locally, Preview/Save completion text could hide backend failures, and inherited/explicit/missing/conflict states needed clearer visual treatment.
behavior_before: The Libraries editor and route-map panels rendered independently, route-map evidence did not clearly disclose stale saved-backend scope while edits were dirty, and several staged/reset/preview/save states relied on terse text only.
behavior_after: The Libraries tab keeps selected profile context synchronized, marks staged editor and patch state, discloses saved-backend route-map scope, surfaces backend warnings and validation evidence, and uses clearer state styling without taking ownership of persistence outside backend Preview/Save.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_settings_launch_smoke.WebViewBrowserSettingsLaunchSmoke.test_real_browser_hands_staged_settings_patch_to_launch_without_saving -q - blocked before Libraries assertions by existing dirty Queue runtime failure: ReferenceError resetQueueManualOrderLoadedKeys is not defined in assets/queueView.js:860
rollback_plan: Revert the Libraries WebView, CSS, test, generated summary, and this change packet updates.
notes:
WebView display and staging only. Backend Preview/Save remains authoritative; this change must not launch processing, mutate queue state, publish, rename, drain pending publish, or touch media.
Address Libraries tab staged/saved clarity, route-map trust, profile feedback, and state-color audit findings.
Implemented Libraries staged/saved state strip, route-map saved-evidence context, profile sync, stale async guards, warning/status colors, reset/default feedback, validation proof rows, generated summaries, and focused regression coverage.
